use or peeling it under cold water can
alleviate this problem.  Onions can be
served raw or cooked and can be added to
numerous other foods as a flavoring.
Cooking onions tends to soften them and
removes any sharpness from the flavor.
However, because heat makes onions
bitter, they should be cooked over low to
medium heat.  Onions can be boiled,
steamed, baked, sautéed, scalloped, or
grilled.
Nutrient Composition
Raw onions contain phytochemicals that
include antioxidants, which promote
health.
